prompt: A character sprite sheet of 4 different villagers for a cozy island farming game, drawn at EXACTLY the same pixel size and chibi proportions as the characters in the reference. Two rows of 4 with generous empty white space between every figure. Row 1: each villager standing still facing the camera. Row 2: the same four villagers in the same order, facing the camera with a slight idle pose change (arms moved, head tilted). The four villagers from left to right: 1) an old fisherman with a white beard, weathered tan skin, blue bandana, striped shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a rubber apron; 2) a cheerful plump middle-aged farm woman with a wide straw sun hat with a flower, green dress and a floral apron; 3) a stocky boat captain with a white captain's cap, navy peacoat, grey stubble and a pipe; 4) a young female diving instructor with a short black bob, a wetsuit unzipped to the waist over a tank top, diving goggles pushed up on her forehead.
